name: Custom engine agent
short_description: A custom engine agent is a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent type in which the developer chooses the model and orchestrator, for example built with the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit, as opposed to declarative agents that run on Copilot's own orchestrator.

evidence.quote: the other type of agent that we've talked about for years now is a custom engine agent.
